description: The Arc pool graveyard: every pool we measured with its state (empty or alive) and lifetime volume, so you know which ones nothing can be sold into. $0.025 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

name: arc_graveyard
